viswaocrai.notes: Extract FcF finds and reads many more frames: ISO zone modifiers (UZ, CZ, OZ), frames ruled in light grey, tilted frames, composite and mixed multi-row frames, small position/concentricity symbols told apart. Multi-line frames get one box per row on the annotated drawing.

viswasketch.notes: Bundles Viswa OCR AI 1.1.4: much faster Extract FcF. In-app updates: the app now checks for new versions and can update itself.
